label: Model release
description: A new model, model version or open-weights release is available or officially announced with a date.

label: Research
description: Papers, benchmarks and technical results. Not product launches.

label: Open source
description: Open-weights models, open-source libraries and frameworks, and the licences around them.

label: Tools
description: Developer tools, SDKs, frameworks, APIs and platform features engineers would use.

label: Agents
description: Agentic systems, tool use, MCP, computer use, autonomous workflows.

label: Enterprise adoption
description: How a named company is actually using AI in production, with specifics.

label: Frontier use
description: New, creative or surprising ways people are using AI, including personal stories that are spreading.

label: Creators
description: A newsletter, podcast, YouTube channel, researcher or builder gaining traction.

label: Legislation
description: Actual legislative or regulatory acts only: bills introduced or passed, laws or rules in force, official guidance or codes, enforcement actions. Not commentary.

label: Policy
description: Debate, speeches, consultations and politics about AI regulation, without a legal act.

label: Security
description: Hacks, breaches, leaks, vulnerabilities, jailbreaks and attacks involving AI systems or AI companies.

label: Safety
description: Alignment, evaluations, model behaviour, misuse and red-teaming.

label: Funding
description: Fundraises, valuations, acquisitions, IPOs and big commercial deals.

label: Infrastructure
description: Chips, compute, data centres, energy and inference economics.

label: Advertising
description: AI in adtech, out-of-home, audience measurement, targeting and attribution.

label: Media and publishing
description: Copyright cases, licensing deals, AI in newsrooms and creative production.

label: Computer vision
description: Vision models, video understanding, geospatial and real-world scene analysis.

label: Audio and voice
description: Speech, voice cloning, music and audio models.

label: US federal
description: Jurisdiction: United States federal government, agencies and Congress.

label: EU
description: Jurisdiction: European Union institutions, including the AI Act and the AI Office.

label: Germany
description: Jurisdiction: German federal government and regulators.

label: UK
description: Jurisdiction: UK Parliament, government and regulators such as the ICO, Ofcom and the CMA.
